title: Claude Code Tips and Tricks: 20 Things Power Users Do Differently
summary: Claude Code tips and tricks for power users: 20 specific techniques covering CLAUDE.md setup, prompt engineering, session management, and advanced CI/CD automation. Skip the basics.
body_markdown: CLAUDE.md is a markdown file at your project root that Claude Code reads at the start of every session. It's not optional — it's the difference between Claude guessing your conventions and Claude knowing them. Power users maintain CLAUDE.md like code: they prune it regularly, treat bloat as a bug, and use imports (` @path/to/file` ) to keep it modular. The most effective CLAUDE.md files are under 200 words at the root, with extended context in imported files.
